name: Nonoichi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nonoichi city emblem in white: a disc bearing a purple swirl of two curled strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nonoichi, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 June 1960.

features.role: Nonoichi city emblem — a disc bearing a purple swirl of two curled strokes
